purpose: Compare four native 1-star, four native 3-star, and four native 5-star heroes while varying physique, personality, aptitude, and wardrobe without affinity effects or equipment.

rendering.composition: one weaponless adult, full body, neutral three-quarter standing pose, both hands and both feet visible
rendering.background: warm pale parchment studio wash with a soft grounding shadow
commonInvariants: strong clothing silhouette and readable construction
no frame, stars, text, label, UI, logo, watermark, weapon, armor, active magic, affinity glow, or extra person
candidate art only; generated pixels cannot redefine the manifest
